chat.text: I'm trying to decide which compiler to use for a performance-critical project involving a heavily recursive Fibonacci implementation with memoization. I've heard conflicting things about how GCC and Clang handle tail-call optimization and recursive overhead differently. In your opinion, which one typically produces faster binaries for this kind of workload? I need specific benchmarks to justify this decision.
